gen-gf-tektur-inter: Tektur stretches its lowercase to outsized proportions, with curves left generously open at the ends like bent wire. Inter follows in a plain sans, its big counters keeping a long page of text smooth and easy going.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega reads friendly and modern, its sans-serif letters standing nearly as tall as capitals with a visible gap in every c. Unica One is the one that commands, with huge lowercase eyes and daylight in each curve, and the body font simply keeps the text approachable.
gen-gf-tektur-roboto-slab: Wiry, oversized, and a bit odd: Tektur draws its lowercase big and leaves every curve open at the ends. And Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with open throats on a, c, e and s, gives a longer passage a structured, precise texture.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads wide and approachable, its tall-bodied small letters spaced out like cut ribbon of constant width. Lexend Zetta sits under Luckiest Guy's loud, poured-ink cheer, and that loud-versus-friendly split is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-bitter: Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap in each s, grounds Tilt Neon's tube-like, laser-etched line. The pair's strongest quality is that clash.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-instrument-sans: Commanding is how Tilt Neon lands, with its splayed c terminal and large x-height under short ascenders. Instrument Sans follows with a sans whose pincer-like c and unvarying stroke keep the page modern.
gen-megrim-gf-lexend-peta: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with a skyward x-height line and a c as open as a bent paperclip. And Lexend Peta, a sans-serif with unthinned curves and a wide-mouthed c, feels friendly and sturdy beside it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-lexend-tera: Bookish and a little nostalgic, Mystery Quest opens its jaws on every curve above compact ascenders. Lexend Tera, a plain sans, draws every rounded letter with a plotter-pen line and stepping-stone spacing, so one brings character and the other brings clarity.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with open throats on a, c, e and s, gives Tilt Neon's constant-weight trace a structured partner. And the pair's strongest quality is how that precise, middle-heavy texture stays steady beneath the bold heading.
gen-righteous-gf-montserrat-alternates: Commanding Righteous fills the line with big bowls, while Montserrat Alternates sits beneath it with a paperclip-open c and round letters crowding toward the capital line. Its sans text moves along smoothly.
